description:
Multi use singletrack trail is primarily used for mountain biking but also used for e-biking, trail running and hiking. Rated as a black trail, most people ride from West to East but can be ridden either direction. Expect challenging, punchy climbs with janky descents and great views. Be aware that after large rainfalls the exit out may be flooded. Dog friendly trail.

Distance 3.7 km | Ascent 159m | Descent -257m
directions: Access trail in the One Mile Lake area from Nairn One Mile (West End) or Bob's Loop (East End). (50.300240, -122.809800.)
title: Lumpy's Epic
